title: Rollout onboarding illustration set + responsive screenshot samples for docs
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: produce a compact illustration/sticker set and a set of export-ready console screenshots across breakpoints to support the Rollouts & Version Pinning quickstart and release notes. Deliverables should cover canary, A/B, and fallback policy flows with clear visual affordances for pinned variants, traffic sliders, and automated fallback status. Assets must include dark-mode variants, 2x export sizes for docs/marketing, and annotated screenshot overlays for the developer quickstart docs.
tasks: Audit existing rollout visuals (figma file previous versions) and list redundant states
Design 6 central illustrations: canary funnel, split-traffic dial, pin badge, fallback umbrella, health-check indicator, rollback pulse
Produce accessible color-token mappings and contrast report for each screen (AA/AAA targets)
Export component-level PNG/SVGs and a sticker-sheet for marketing usage
Add microinteraction frames for 2 short Lottie prototypes (toggle pin, failover animation)
Prepare annotated overlays for docs with callouts and copy snippets ready for engineers
Handoff package to front-end: tokens, spacing guidelines, SVG sprites, and recommended CSS classes
design_assets: SVG sprite: drive link (final export) will be added after review
screenshot_notes: Screenshots use live console with synthetic data. Use safe sample names (no customer PII). Include a small top-left badge: 'Quickstart sample'. Each screenshot set should include: annotated version, clean export, and a version with redlines for dev handoff. Filename convention: rollout_<flow>_<breakpoint>_<mode>.png
accessibility_considerations: All important controls (pin toggle, traffic slider, fallback toggle) must reach at least 4.5:1 contrast in default mode and 3:1 in non-critical small text. Provide alt-text drafts for each illustration. Ensure Lottie animations are motion-safe (reduced motion variant provided).
review_comments: 2026-03-03 - Priya Kapoor (PM): Prefer stronger contrast on pin badge in dark mode; avoid blue for failure state
2026-03-06 - Leo Martínez (Eng): We need componentized SVGs so frontend can swap token colors; avoid embedded text in SVGs
2026-03-09 - Nora Blake (Design): Revised funnel illustration to use three distinct colors for canary cohorts instead of gradients
2026-03-12 - Mateo Ruiz (Design): Added mobile-first breakpoints; prepping export pack for handoff
decisions: Keep separate sticker-sheet for marketing vs. docs to avoid legal copy overlap
Use token-based fill colors (brand/semantic tokens) instead of hard-coded hexes for all SVGs
Provide two animation variants: full motion and reduced-motion (prefers-reduced-motion)
next_steps: Finalize color-token mapping and push to design system tokens page
Produce 2 Lottie prototypes and export JSONs for frontend integration
Create annotated screenshots and upload final export pack to Drive by 2026-03-18
Open PR with sprite and exported assets: assign ENG-50100 for integration
